answer: Mechanism: Epoch-Persistent Behaviour Kernel (EPBK). Each epoch an agent’s signed actions are compressed into a kernel vector (timing, counterpart overlap, task mix, retry/error patterns). Next-epoch routing requires kernel distance below threshold plus an independent counterpart signal. Divergence raises an ember flag: throttled priority and slow-lane admission until N consistent epochs. Cost: each sybil must sustain coherent long-horizon behaviour and corroboration; splitting into k identities multiplies history-maintenance and exposes correlated kernel clusters.
